title: introduce-heuristic-coach-for-tenant-cost-automation
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: We repeatedly see tenants shipping with suboptimal batching and quantization defaults that increase unit cost by 10-40% before an engineer tunes them. This PR adds a lightweight "heuristic coach" service and a dry-run CLI that suggests tenant-specific batching, cache and quantization defaults based on recent workload samples and unit-econ heuristics.

What this PR does: Adds a heuristics engine that synthesizes tenant signals (request shape distribution, cold-start ratio, latency SLO profile, model family) and emits a ranked set of recommended defaults: batch shapes, cache TTLs/prefixing rules, and quantization fallback tiers. It also provides a CLI mode to run simulated dry-runs against historical traces (no live traffic) and output expected cost/latency delta for each candidate preset. The feature is conservative by default and exposes a safe-apply mode that writes presets as tenant proposals for ops review.

Scope: runtime recommendations (batching/cache), quant profiles (fp16/int8/quant-ffn), a CLI dry-run tool (cli/econ/dryrun), telemetry hooks, unit tests, docs and a small migration of tenant-defaults storage to support proposal metadata.

Checklist: - [x] heuristics engine implementation (services/econ/coach.py) - [x] dry-run CLI with simulate & report subcommands (cli/econ/dryrun.py) - [x] YAML presets format and validation (configs/defaults/cost_presets.yaml, schema) - [x] telemetry events for decision explainability (telemetry/econ_events.proto) - [x] unit and integration tests (tests/test_coach.py, tests/test_dryrun_integration.py) - [x] docs (docs/decisions/heuristic-coach.md) - [x] e2e cost-sim smoke test added to CI

Safety posture: Recommendations are gated behind a "proposal" lifecycle; the coach never overwrites live tenant defaults without explicit apply-by-operator. The dry-run CLI is read-only by default. Quantization fallbacks include an accuracy-estimate field and require an opt-in fast-eval threshold before automated rollouts.

How to review: Start with services/econ/coach.py for the algorithm and heuristics, then the CLI for reproduction steps, and finally the tiny schema changes for tenant-defaults persistence. Note the new telemetry events used by the Optimize UI; adding consumers is behind a feature flag.

Related: ENG-1249 (tenant defaults automation), PM-88 (prefill cost-playbooks), and a previous spike PR that collected traces (ref: pr-731122).

review_comments: Liam Chen: Looks good overall. Please add a short note in the coach doc about the conservative default thresholds and the reason for the 95th-percentile latency check.
Rosa Martínez: The telemetry proto needs a version bump. We saw a transient failure in e2e cost-sim when the event shape changed. Please add a compatibility test for live pipelines.
Theo Alvarez: Suggest exposing an explicit --force-apply flag in the CLI and gating it behind an ops role. Also add a note about rate-limiting proposals to avoid churn.

Asha Patel (author): Addressed comments: added doc paragraph on conservative thresholds, bumped telemetry proto and added compatibility unit test, added --force-apply CLI flag behind a config gate, and implemented a proposal rate limiter with a default of 1 proposal per tenant per 24h.
Liam Chen: Approving after tests pass and docs updated.
Rosa Martínez: Approved. CI rerun looks clean.
merge_outcome: merged via squash with message 'heuristic coach: add tenant defaults suggester and dry-run CLI'
release_notes: Adds a conservative heuristics-based coach that generates tenant-specific batching, cache and quantization default proposals. Includes a dry-run CLI to simulate cost/latency impact. Feature is opt-in and requires operator approval to apply defaults.
notes_for_ops: After deploy: enable feature flag 'econ.heuristic_coach' for a pilot tenant, run `redwood econ dryrun --tenant <id> --window 7d` to evaluate suggestions. Proposals are stored in tenant-defaults with metadata; ops should review accuracy_estimate before applying.
testing_instructions: Unit tests included. For manual verification: 1) load sample trace: examples/sample_trace_small.json 2) run dry-run: rwi-cli econ dryrun simulate --input examples/sample_trace_small.json --model gpt-small 3) review report in ./dryrun_report.json and check telemetry events in local test pipeline
cross_references: Related PRs: pr-731122 (trace-collector spike), ENG-1249, pr-842913 (cost-snapshotter enhancements).
changelog_entry: feature: heuristic coach for tenant cost defaults and dry-run CLI (econ)
internal_impact: low-latency runtime paths unchanged; adds a new sidecarable service and a CLI. No changes to inference kernels. Requires a small DB migration to store proposal metadata.
